detailed_descriptions.en: You and your crew got the party location wrong, and your ride broke down. Navigate through unforgiving waters using a beat-up ship that will from now on serve as your new, musty home. This won't be an easy task, however, as you'll be facing the greatest enemy of primary school students: physics. Add to that falling boulders, sea mines, dangerous fauna, and much, much more. Fortunately, the ship is equipped with a harpoon system that is sure to help you overcome even the toughest obstacles. The number of harpoons will increase as the game progresses, allowing for a creative approach to the problems you encounter. Since this is a trip out on the water, fishing is an absolute must. Sell your fish to buy items that will make your survival easier. Use gathered wood and scrap to repair the boat so you don't sink before reaching your destination. Remember to take care of yourself, too—but if things go south, all is not lost! Your crew can revive you using a Golden Fish. Remember, though, that the destination isn't the most important thing; it's the journey and the company you keep along the way. The more you stray off the beaten path, the more items you'll be able to gather—and maybe you'll even uncover the secret of Laba the Frog.
